verdict.rationale: Metronome fires webhooks on events such as a threshold being reached or an invoice finalizing, and it supports configurable event-driven behaviors like credit auto-recharge or gated access when credits run out. It also automatically creates a Stripe invoice when an invoice finalizes. These are fixed, built-in triggers plus outbound notifications rather than a general user-defined rule engine, so custom actions require your own webhook handlers. Missing for 10: a general-purpose rule/workflow builder for defining arbitrary event-to-action rules, documentation of configurable conditions and actions beyond preset behaviors, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
